hero.title: Driving Egypt Forward, Together.
hero.subtitle: Zabatly is Egypt's smart car rental platform, powered by AI and designed to make transportation simple, safe, and accessible for everyone.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: Born from a Real Problem
story.p1: We noticed that renting a car in Egypt was complicated, untrustworthy, and expensive. There had to be a better way.
story.p2: So we built Zabatly: a platform where car owners list their vehicles and renters browse, book, and pay, all in one place. With AI-powered recommendations, identity verification, and a driver marketplace, Zabatly is more than a rental app.
story.p3: Our mission is simple: make transportation accessible, trustworthy, and smart for every Egyptian.
story.quote: We didn't just build an app. We built a bridge between people who have cars and people who need them.

why.label: Why Zabatly
why.title: What Makes Us Different
why.subtitle: The features that set Zabatly apart from traditional car rental services.
why.item1Desc: Our intelligent assistant analyzes your needs and recommends the best vehicle, price, and availability for your trip.
why.item2Desc: Every renter and host goes through identity verification. You always know who you're dealing with.
why.item3Desc: Need a driver? Browse our vetted driver marketplace and book one alongside your vehicle.
why.item4Desc: No hidden fees. See the full cost upfront with clear daily rates and payment options.

values.label: Our Values
values.title: What We Stand For
values.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we build.
values.trustDesc: Every user is verified. Every booking is protected. We take safety seriously so you can rent with confidence.
values.speedDesc: From browsing to booking, everything is designed to be fast, intuitive, and hassle-free.
values.aiDesc: Our intelligent assistant helps you find the perfect car, compare prices, and get personalized recommendations.
values.localDesc: Zabatly understands the Egyptian market: local pricing, Arabic support, and features tailored to local needs.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subtitle: Join Egyptians who trust Zabatly for smarter, safer car rentals.
